audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phase reasons are shared template text keyed to 'Powder Kegs's cooldown' — a barrel charge system, not a single cooldown you can wait out.
audit.why: What decides the stages is Parrrley (4.5s) chipping you off the wave, Remove Scurvy (22s) cleansing your Q slow, and Cannon Barrage being global from level 6.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around Parrrley's range, Remove Scurvy's cleanse and Cannon Barrage's global reach.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike said only 'his ultimate changes the math too' and the 2-item stage named no reason at all.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage at 6 is a 160s global that changes where you can be, not how the duel goes; Gangplank's real scaling spike is his second item and full barrel uptime.
audit.corrected: phases[4] now names the global, phases[6] states that his barrel scaling beats your single-target burst if the game runs long.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent: Remove Scurvy cleanses your Five Point Strike slow, Parrrley is target-locked so Twilight Shroud blanks it while barrels still land, and Cannon Barrage is global.
audit.why: The kit file flags Remove Scurvy heal (it is his cleanse) and Cannon Barrage global. Twilight Shroud makes Akali unable to be selected, which stops target-locked casts but not ground-placed barrels. All three are listed in champ-data/_kits/_missing/akali.json for this matchup.
audit.corrected: Cleanse stated in phases[3].why and dontsFull[1].d; the Shroud split in phases[1].why and report[5].t; the global in phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Parrrley 4.5s flat, Remove Scurvy 22/20/18/16/14, Cannon Barrage 160/140/120; your W is 20s and E 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Let him scale to 2 items' was described as 'burning it for tiny value'.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title.

edits.before: Pop barrels — shroud his combo, all-in early. Akali wins the Powder Kegs cooldown windows.
edits.after: Pop barrels — shroud his Parrrley, all-in early. Akali wins the Remove Scurvy cooldown windows.

edits.before: Deny barrels and all-in early. Track Powder Kegs before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny barrels and all-in early. Remove Scurvy is 22s at rank 1 — that is when your slow sticks.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Gangplank contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Parrrley is on 4.5s at 625 range and pays him gold for hitting you. Farm at Q tip; you cannot win the chip war.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Gangplank's Powder Kegs is down.
edits.after: Shroud blanks Parrrley because it is target-locked, but ground-placed barrels still detonate on you.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gangplank must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: E-mark him across a barrel line, dash in, and Shroud the return before the chain can finish.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Powder Kegs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Remove Scurvy (22s) wipes your Q slow, so commit only once he has spent it on something else.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Cannon Barrage (160s) is global — being low anywhere on the map is now a decision, not a default.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight the moment it lands, before his barrels scale.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Gangplank carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, but barrels scale past single-target burst — close the game rather than trade chip with him forever.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Parrrley (4.5s): target-locked, so smoke blanks it. - Remove Scurvy (22s at rank 1): cleanses your Q slow — commit after he spends it. - Cannon Barrage (160s): global, so low HP anywhere is a choice.

edits.before: Q Gangplank at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550 outside barrel range, E-mark and dash once Remove Scurvy is spent, then Shroud the chain.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Standing on a barrel line with Shroud down — the chain slows you and Parrrley finishes it.

edits.before: Q Gangplank at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: One auto kills a keg before it arms — deny the chain and you deny him the gold that comes with it.

edits.before: Gangplank wastes Powder Kegs — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Smoke blanks the target-locked Parrrley, though not the barrels.

edits.before: That is Gangplank's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: A linked barrel chain slows you into every follow-up he owns — break it early.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His barrel damage scales straight past your single-target burst.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Parrrley is on 4.5s at 625 range against your 550 kunai — you will not win a chip war here.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Parrrley is target-locked so Shroud blanks it; barrels are not. Remove Scurvy cleanses your Q slow.

notes: The kit file lists Powder Keg with cooldown 0 because it is charge-based, so the full layer's repeated 'track Powder Kegs's cooldown' framing was never actionable — I replaced it with Remove Scurvy's 22s, which is the cooldown you can actually count. Cannon Barrage carries a trueDamage flag in the kit file; Riot's description does not say the barrage itself is true damage, so I wrote nothing about resistances and only used the global reach, which the description does state.
